items.title: Your Proof of Delivery Won’t Get Your Inventory Back. Amazon Doesn’t Care That the Pallet Showed Up.
items.zh_title: 签收证明救不回丢件库存，Amazon 只认入库数量
items.zh_oneliner: 承运商的签收证明打不赢 Amazon 丢件索赔，托盘送到不等于入库，每个货件只有一次索赔机会，发货前就要备好证据。
items.en_oneliner: A carrier's proof of delivery won't win an Amazon lost-inbound claim — a delivered pallet isn't the same as received units, and you get only one claim per shipment, so build your evidence before it ships.

items.title: The Amazon Agency Report Clients Can Actually Make Decisions From
items.zh_title: 能让客户真正拿来做决策的亚马逊代运营报告长什么样
items.zh_oneliner: 一页纸的亚马逊代运营报告，把贡献、建议和负责人串起来，让客户看完就能拍板。
items.en_oneliner: A one-page Amazon agency report that ties contribution, a recommendation and clear owners together so clients can decide at a glance.
